answer: We formalize a Sybil-resistant mechanism where each identity must lock collateral in a decentralized vault. To deter identity multiplication, we employ a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function acting as a cryptographic lantern, illuminating malicious epoch transitions. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix guarantees that any adversary attempting to partition the consensus via a lightweight sparrow node faces a negative expected utility, as the penalty exceeds potential double-spend gains. Consequently, honest replication remains the unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
